task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Solve a 0/1 knapsack (values [12, 7, 12, 2, 6, 9], weights [1, 7, 3, 3, 1, 6], capacity 10) by building a penalized QUBO in dimod (slack-variable encoding for the capacity constraint) and sampling with SimulatedAnnealingSampler. Compare to brute force. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
